project_type: Laravel 12 micro SaaS — Blade + Alpine.js 3 + Tailwind CSS 3 + Vite 5 + Filament 5 admin
language: PHP 8.3+ (declared ^8.3 in composer.json, 8.5 in dev); interface text pt-BR; code/comments English
build_system: Vite 5 via laravel-vite-plugin; entry: resources/css/app.css + resources/js/app.js; output: public/build/. Tailwind JIT. Terser minify with drop_console. Run: npm run build
test_framework: Pest 4 (pestphp/pest ^4.7 + pest-plugin-laravel ^4.1). Runs via php artisan test. Namespace Tests\; test files in tests/Feature/ and tests/Unit/.
test_command: composer test   (which runs: php artisan optimize:clear --ansi && php artisan test)
verification_instructions: 1. composer test — must pass with zero failures. 2. npm run build — must exit 0. 3. composer lint (pint --test) — zero violations. 4. composer analyse (phpstan --memory-limit=1G) — zero errors at level 6.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/build/manifest.json and public/build/assets/* are produced by npm run build. Do not commit them (they are in .gitignore). No PHP snapshots checked in.
environment_constraints: Do NOT modify routes/api.php, .env, or any file under resources/views/filament/. Do NOT alter existing migrations. Do NOT push to main/master — work on feature/phase11-ui-refactor. SweetAlert2 and Font Awesome 6 are loaded from CDN (not npm) — do not add them as npm packages.
contribution_requirements: Every PHP file must have declare(strict_types=1). Interface text pt-BR; variable names and code comments English. PRG pattern on all POST redirects. All forms: autocomplete='off', @csrf, honeypot on public forms. No raw {!! !!} output without explicit sanitization.
key_patterns: Controller → Service (interface) → Repository (interface) → Model. FormRequest for validation. DTOs (spatie/laravel-data) between layers. Service bindings in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php lines 136-163. Views use @extends('layouts.app|guest|landing') + @section('content'). Reusable UI components: x-ui.breadcrumb, x-ui.button, x-ui.field, x-ui.input, x-ui.honeypot, x-ui.tip, x-ui.alert, x-ui.section-card, x-ui.page-header, x-ui.empty-state, x-seo.json-ld. Dark mode: Alpine.js darkMode store + localStorage + 'dark' class on <html>. Loading overlay: showLoading(text)/hideLoading() globals in app.js. Tailwind custom palette: primary (green), secondary (teal), accent (amber), surface (charcoal). Custom utilities: .glass, .glass-border, .btn, .btn-primary, .input, .num, .text-gradient.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/ — web controllers (+ Auth/ and Api/V1/ subdirs); app/Http/Requests/ — FormRequests; app/Services/ — service implementations; app/Interfaces/Services/ — service interfaces; app/Interfaces/Repositories/ — repository interfaces; app/Repositories/ — repository implementations (bound in AppServiceProvider); app/DTOs/ — spatie/laravel-data DTOs; app/Models/ — Eloquent models; resources/views/ — Blade templates (layouts/, components/layout/, components/ui/, dashboard/, wallets/, transactions/, goals/, budgets/, categories/, calculators/, simulators/, reports/, pages/, auth/, errors/, landing/); resources/css/app.css — Tailwind + custom utilities; resources/js/ — app.js, charts.js, forms.js, consent.js; tests/Feature/ — feature tests (Auth/, Authorization/, Billing/ subdirs); tests/Unit/ — unit tests; tests/Fakes/ — test doubles; docs/ — project documentation
